emergency_script: That sounds like it needs urgent attention. If there's any difficulty breathing or swallowing, please hang up and call 999 now. Otherwise, NHS 111 can direct you to an emergency dentist tonight, and I can pass your number straight to our on-call team.
pricing_ranges: Invisalign: typically two thousand eight hundred to five and a half thousand pounds. Composite veneers: from around two hundred and fifty pounds per tooth. Porcelain veneers: from around six hundred and fifty pounds per tooth. Teeth whitening: from around three hundred and fifty pounds. New patient check-up: sixty-five pounds.
practice_facts: Free consultations for cosmetic treatments (Invisalign, veneers, whitening). 0% finance available on treatments over five hundred pounds. On-site parking. The practice is on the High Street, two minutes from the railway station. Principal dentist: Dr. Shah. New patients welcome.
